x: Our congratulations and best wishes to Stan Botwright (now of the R.A.F.) and Tony Bellchambers (now 2nd Lt. in the Royal Artillery) and Syd Jones (now of the Army) on the occasion of their recent marriages.
Watts are in the R.A.F., Tony Bellchambers holds a commission in the Royal Artillery, W.

These things will continue; and the success the Club has enjoyed will carry on, for the same spirit permeates the younger members. We have walkers like Tony Bellchambers, Ted Elliott, Bob McMullen (Junior), W.
Tony Bellchambers, having read in the B.N.L. the doings by fellow members, has sent home for his shoes. Rodney Stone was once again amongst us at the A.G.M.
Tony Bellchambers, with S.E.A.C., has had a short spell in hospital with malaria, but is now fit again. Francis is still with East African Command.
